narrations.title: The Royal Decree
narrations.narration: Leo the Lion loved being the boss of the jungle. He marched with stiff, exaggerated steps, though he nearly tripped over his own royal red cape.

narrations.title: Robby's Lightbulb Moment
narrations.narration: This was a big problem for Robby the Rabbit, whose ears loved to wiggle! As he saw his sad friends, Robby suddenly froze as a brilliant idea struck him.

narrations.title: The Great Deception
narrations.narration: Robby bounced over to Leo with high energy, rubbing his paws together as he delivered the shocking news.

narrations.title: The March to the Well
narrations.narration: Leo was far too prideful to believe another king existed. He puffed out his chest and marched toward the old stone well, his cape flapping wildly.

narrations.title: The Mirror Image
narrations.narration: Robby pointed toward the well. Leo leaned over the edge and saw a grumpy lion with a tilted crown staring back at him from the clear water.

narrations.title: The Royal Splash
narrations.narration: Leo let out a loud, theatrical roar, and the reflection roared back! Thinking he was fighting a rival, Leo jumped in with a giant splash!

narrations.title: The Rescue
narrations.narration: Leo floated in the water, looking very soggy and silly. Seeing the lion's plight, Robby reached into his blue leather satchel and pulled out a sturdy rope to help him out.

narrations.title: A New Way of Ruling
narrations.narration: Leo realized that Robby was much smarter than he was. From that day on, the animals wiggled their ears as much as they wanted, while Leo practiced walking without tripping.
